sample.title: Delivery (Incoterms)
sample.text: DDP — Delivered Duty Paid to the delivery address stated above, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

sample.title: Inspection & acceptance
sample.text: Goods and services are subject to inspection on receipt. Non-conforming items may be rejected within 7 business days and returned at the supplier’s cost.

sample.title: Warranty
sample.text: The supplier warrants all goods and services against defects for 12 months from acceptance.

sample.title: Late delivery
sample.text: Liquidated damages of 1% of the PO value per week of delay apply, capped at 5% of the PO value.

sample.title: Taxes
sample.text: Prices are inclusive of PPN (VAT) where applicable. A valid tax invoice (Faktur Pajak) is required for payment.

sample.title: PO reference
sample.text: This purchase order number must be quoted on all invoices, delivery notes and correspondence.

sample.title: Governing law
sample.text: This order is governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia; disputes are subject to the courts of Jakarta.
